title: Native representative square and coherence after ordinary comparison
statement: Given all inputs of lem-sf-native-weil-tensor-ringed-derived-square, an ordinaryModel satisfying its normalization and naturality clauses, and the fixed native one-K-flat model, there exist a tensor-forgetting isomorphism t, a representative square NativeWeilRingedModelForget with the two exact forgetting factors, and TensorCoherence for the transported native structure.

source.place: Native tensor transport, geometric tensor part of steps 1 and 3; Stacks 06YU, 0FPT

proof.text: Conjugate the supplied ringed TensorComparison through the native and ordinary localized equivalences and the ordinaryModel. On flat-term representatives the equation is the underived Hom square together with the chain summand comparison; the explicit native model and its naturality reduce the composite to the representative equation. K-flat replacement and the orbit-sum retract extend it to every native K-flat first input and arbitrary second input.

source.place: Native tensor transport, geometric tensor part of step 3

proof.text: Transport the four coherence equations of d through the same equivalences and tensor identification. The transported associator, left and right unitors, and symmetry are exactly TensorCoherence for nativeWeilRingedMonoidal and nativeWeilRingedSymmetric.
